user_query: I'm a fashion enthusiast and I want to update my wardrobe. Can you fetch the products from the 'clothing' category in My Store API? It would be great if you could also provide me with the used prices of GPUs to explore the possibility of buying a high-performance graphics card for gaming. Additionally, fetch the trending and interesting listings from Etsy to explore fashion-related items.

TaskList.description: Fetch the products from the 'clothing' category in My Store API.
Fetch the used prices of GPUs from a price comparison API.
Fetch the trending and interesting listings from Etsy.
